items.text: Choosing between UPSC and software engineering means choosing between a long, uncertain exam path to public service and a skills-based career that you can start sooner, and a sensible plan limits risk by setting a clear preparation window, building a backup skill and checking your finances.
Decide your reason first, public service or technology, then set a fixed preparation window with a backup skill, or start a software role and prepare part time.
Check the official notification before you plan years around it.
